executive_summary: voidStaleAndCollapseObligations re-emits stale chairman decision questions via enqueueChairmanSms without minting a fresh reply token or staging chairman_notifications, so a chairman's reply can never match. This PRD closes that gap.

functional_requirements.requirement: voidStaleAndCollapseObligations (lib/chairman/sms-outbound-worker.js:357) must mint a fresh sms_reply_token + sms_reply_token_expires_at on the linked chairman_decisions row and insert a chairman_notifications row BEFORE calling enqueueChairmanSms to re-emit a stale, still-pending decision_question
functional_requirements.description: Reuse the existing staging mechanism (stageDecisionSmsNotification / updateChairmanDecisionSmsFields / insertChairmanSmsNotification in lib/chairman/sms-bridge.js) rather than hand-rolling new token logic, mirroring exactly what sendChairmanSMS does at chairman-sms-gate/index.js:664 before its own dispatch at :700
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: After a re-emit, chairman_decisions.sms_reply_token_expires_at for the decision is a fresh timestamp strictly greater than the original (pre-re-emit) expiry
AC-2: After a re-emit, a new chairman_notifications row exists with the correct decision_id and status='queued' (matching insertChairmanSmsNotification's contract)
AC-3: The existing supersede behavior (original obligation -> status=canceled, last_error=re_asked_as:<new_id>) is unchanged

functional_requirements.requirement: The re-emit branch must resolve the chairman's identity (chairmanUserId, chairmanEmail, chairmanPhone) before staging, since sms-outbound-worker.js currently has no such resolution
functional_requirements.description: Reuse the existing resolver used by the gate (resolveChairmanUserId, referenced at chairman-sms-gate/index.js:657) rather than writing a second resolution path
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: The staging call passes a real chairmanUserId/email/phone resolved via the existing helper, not a hardcoded or null value
AC-2: If chairman identity resolution fails, the re-emit fails closed (falls back to the pre-fix void/leave-owed behavior) rather than sending an unmatchable SMS anyway

functional_requirements.requirement: A chairman's SMS reply to a re-emitted decision_question must resolve to outcome=answered (not expired) in handleInboundSmsReply (lib/chairman/sms-bridge.js:722)
functional_requirements.description: This is the end-to-end behavioral proof that FR-1/FR-2 actually close the loop, not just that a token column got written
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: A simulated inbound reply within the new token's TTL window, matched against the re-emitted decision's fresh token, resolves outcome=answered
AC-2: The stale, expired original token no longer matches anything (it was invalidated or superseded, never left live and ambiguous)

functional_requirements.requirement: lib/adam/chairman-held-send-release.js:511 and :575 (heartbeat_status kind, also calling enqueueChairmanSms with a decisionId) are explicitly documented as OUT OF SCOPE for this SD
functional_requirements.description: These are non-reply-expecting notices (kind=heartbeat_status), not decision_question rows -- they have no reply-matching requirement. Documenting this prevents silent scope ambiguity (VALIDATION sub-agent finding, evidence row 3037cac9-6caf-4d5f-9d4c-00139a5f22c6)
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: A code comment at both call sites (or a shared helper's docblock) states plainly that heartbeat_status notices are intentionally excluded from the staging requirement, citing this SD
AC-2: No functional change is made to chairman-held-send-release.js in this SD

functional_requirements.requirement: The existing regression suite (tests/unit/chairman/sms-outbound-reconcile.test.js: TS-3, QF-20260829-320, SEC-2, TS-11) must continue to pass unmodified in its existing assertions
functional_requirements.description: These tests already exercise summary.reEmitted counts and the re_asked_as: supersede marker; the fix must extend, not replace, this coverage
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: npx vitest run tests/unit/chairman/sms-outbound-reconcile.test.js passes with 0 pre-existing assertions removed or weakened
AC-2: New assertions for token-refresh and chairman_notifications-insert are added to the SAME test cases (TS-3 and friends), not a disconnected new file

technical_requirements.requirement: Do not construct a new Twilio client, token-generation scheme, or notification-insert path in sms-outbound-worker.js
technical_requirements.rationale: lib/chairman/sms-bridge.js already owns token generation + TOKEN_TTL_MS (15min) + insertChairmanSmsNotification; a second implementation would fork the two-stack hazard this codebase has already been hardened against (see chairman-sms-gate/index.js's own docblock on the -B durable send path)

technical_requirements.requirement: The staging call must run strictly before the enqueueChairmanSms(...) call at line 357-360, inside the same synchronous flow, so a staging failure can prevent the send (fail-closed), matching sendChairmanSMS's own ordering at chairman-sms-gate/index.js:664 -> :700
technical_requirements.rationale: A send-then-stage ordering would recreate the exact QF-20260725-738 class of bug this codebase already fixed once (enqueue reported as delivery before verification)

technical_requirements.requirement: Preserve the NO-DOUBLE-SEND / atomic-claim guarantees already in sms_outbound_obligations (status='owed'->'sending' claim predicate) -- the fix must not introduce a second obligation row per stale decision or race two staging calls for the same decision_id
technical_requirements.rationale: voidStaleAndCollapseObligations already has a documented supersede pattern (original->canceled, new row created); staging must attach to the SAME re-emit flow, not run twice if the sweep is invoked concurrently

system_architecture.overview: sms-outbound-worker.js's stale-decision re-emit branch gains a staging step that reuses lib/chairman/sms-bridge.js's existing token/notification machinery, making the durable-queue re-emit path behaviorally identical (for staging purposes) to the normal chairman-sms-gate send path.

components.name: voidStaleAndCollapseObligations
components.responsibility: Detects stale, still-pending decision_question obligations and triggers a fresh re-ask

components.name: stageDecisionSmsNotification (reused)
components.responsibility: Mints sms_reply_token/expiry on chairman_decisions and inserts a chairman_notifications row

components.name: resolveChairmanUserId (reused)
components.responsibility: Resolves chairman identity fields needed for staging

system_architecture.data_flow: voidStaleAndCollapseObligations detects a stale, pending decision_question -> resolves chairman identity -> calls stageDecisionSmsNotification (mints token, inserts notification) -> calls enqueueChairmanSms with the SAME decisionId -> supersedes the original obligation. A later inbound reply from the chairman is matched by handleInboundSmsReply against the fresh, live token.

test_scenarios.scenario: Stale decision_question, still pending, re-emits with a fresh token and notification
test_scenarios.given: An owed decision_question obligation older than DEFAULT_STALE_THRESHOLD_MS with decision_id X, chairman_decisions.status=pending for X
test_scenarios.then: chairman_decisions.sms_reply_token_expires_at for X is refreshed (> now, > the pre-run value) and a new chairman_notifications row exists for X

test_scenarios.scenario: Chairman replies to a re-emitted question within the fresh token's TTL
test_scenarios.given: A re-emitted decision_question with a fresh, live token

test_scenarios.scenario: Decision already resolved (non-pending) while its obligation is stale
test_scenarios.given: chairman_decisions.status != pending for decision_id X, X's obligation is stale
test_scenarios.then: the obligation is voided (status=canceled, decided:<status>), NOT re-emitted, no staging call made -- unchanged from current behavior

test_scenarios.scenario: Second re-emit cycle after the first re-emit also goes unanswered and stale
test_scenarios.given: A re-emitted obligation itself goes stale again
test_scenarios.then: a SECOND fresh token/notification is minted (not the first re-emit's now-stale token reused)

test_scenarios.scenario: Chairman identity resolution fails during re-emit
test_scenarios.given: resolveChairmanUserId (or equivalent) throws or returns null
test_scenarios.then: the re-emit is aborted (no enqueueChairmanSms call), the original obligation remains owed for the next sweep, and a warning is logged -- never sends an unmatchable message

test_scenarios.given: An existing heartbeat_status enqueueChairmanSms call at chairman-held-send-release.js:511/575
test_scenarios.when: the fix for FR-1 is deployed
test_scenarios.then: no behavior change for heartbeat_status kind -- confirmed by the existing chairman-held-send-release.test.js suite still passing unmodified

acceptance_criteria: npx vitest run tests/unit/chairman/sms-outbound-reconcile.test.js passes with all pre-existing TS-3/QF-20260829-320/SEC-2/TS-11 assertions intact plus new token/notification assertions
A simulated re-emit -> inbound-reply round trip resolves outcome=answered, not expired
chairman-held-send-release.js is documented as out-of-scope and its own test suite (tests/unit/adam/chairman-held-send-release.test.js) is unmodified and passing

No second Twilio client or token-generation scheme is introduced -- grep confirms sms-outbound-worker.js imports stageDecisionSmsNotification (or equivalent) from sms-bridge.js rather than reimplementing it

risks.risk: This touches chairman authentication/reply-matching (sms_reply_token generation and staging), flagged CRITICAL security risk by the RISK sub-agent (score 9/10) purely on keyword match (auth, security, token)
risks.mitigation: The fix reuses the EXISTING, already-audited token-generation and staging code path (stageDecisionSmsNotification) verbatim rather than writing new crypto/auth logic -- it closes a gap in when that path is called, not how tokens are generated. A SECURITY sub-agent review is still requested at EXEC-TO-PLAN despite infrastructure-type normally skipping it, given the RISK sub-agent's CRITICAL flag.
risks.rollback_plan: Revert the single commit adding the staging call; the re-emit branch returns to its current (buggy but stable) behavior with no data loss, since sms_outbound_obligations rows are unaffected by the staging insert itself

risks.risk: Regression to the existing, currently-passing reconcile-worker test suite (TS-3, QF-20260829-320, SEC-2, TS-11) which asserts reEmitted counts and the re_asked_as: supersede marker
risks.mitigation: Extend the existing test cases with new assertions rather than replacing them; run the full suite before and after the change and diff the pass/fail set
risks.rollback_plan: Revert the commit; the pre-existing test suite (already green) is the safety net

risks.risk: Scope creep into lib/adam/chairman-held-send-release.js, which has a similar-looking but functionally distinct call pattern (heartbeat_status, not decision_question)
risks.mitigation: FR-4 explicitly documents these call sites as out of scope with a code comment; no functional changes are made there in this SD
risks.rollback_plan: N/A -- no code changes made to this file in this SD

Add the end-to-end re-emit -> inbound-reply integration test proving outcome=answered

technical_decisions: Reuse stageDecisionSmsNotification rather than routing the re-emit through the full sendChairmanSMS gate, since the gate applies rubric/spend-cap/quiet-window checks appropriate for a FRESH decision ask, not a re-emit of an already-approved-to-ask decision -- PLAN should confirm this is the right layer (staging fn, not full gate) at PLAN-TO-EXEC
Resolve chairman identity via the existing resolveChairmanUserId helper rather than duplicating chairman lookup logic in the worker

patterns_identified: stageDecisionSmsNotification is the sole token-minting/notification-staging function; all correctly-ordered call sites run it BEFORE dispatch
TOKEN_TTL_MS (15min) is always shorter than the re-emit staleness threshold (6h), so the bug is guaranteed to fire every time the branch is reached, not a rare race
key_decisions: Fix at the staging-call level (reuse stageDecisionSmsNotification), not by routing the re-emit through the full sendChairmanSMS gate, to avoid re-applying rubric/spend-cap checks meant for fresh asks
